transcript.dialogue: I'm Mira. Do you usually knock on tables, or is that just for cafes that are about to close on us?
Just for the closing ones. My name's Dex. It's nice to meet you, Mira.
Nice to meet you too, Dex. Are you working on something right now, or did you just come straight from a studio?
I teach pottery, so the clay tends to stay with me. You have ink on your cuffs—do you write or draw?
I make maps, mostly of places that tend to shift if you blink. But let's look at that chair stacking — do you think they'll lock us in if we don't pick a direction right now?
transcript.action: draws a quick directional arrow on a napkin

transcript.dialogue: Maps that shift sound exhausting. I spent years on fire and I prefer things staying put.
Well, most things stay where you put them. But how do you handle it when you're headed north and the street just isn't there anymore?
I just turn around and find a bench. We should grab that coffee without any cameras soon—let's swap numbers.
Deal. Let's trade numbers and you can show me that studio sometime. My number's yours.
I'd like that. It's been really nice talking to you, Mira. Let's definitely grab that coffee soon.
transcript.action: exits into the cool air together

transcript.dialogue: Good to see you again, Dex. At least these menus have the same number of pages we left off with.
It's really good to see you too, Mira. At least nobody's handing out maps this time.
True. Though if we had one right now, we could probably find a way out from between them.
We could just stare at the bread basket until they stop finishing each other's sentences.
Honestly, staring at the bread basket sounds like the safest route. Let's definitely keep it that way.
Don't mind him, Mira. Jim thinks every room is a soundstage.
At least he brought his own soundtrack. Though I think that stunt double story cost us our appetizer.
Well, we survived the soundstage. Can I walk you home? I'd like to see you again without an audience.
I would love that, Dex. There's a spot just around the corner that's much quieter.
That sounds really nice. Can I take you there?
